_note: Platform delivery profiles applied at the compose stage. Set brief.output.render_profile to a key below; tools/apply_profile.py resolves it to concrete dimensions + an FFmpeg fit filter + caption/safe-margin guidance. safe_margins are percentages of frame height/width to keep clear of platform UI (buttons, captions, progress bars). caption.size_pct is caption height as a fraction of frame height.

youtube_landscape.notes: Standard horizontal. Bottom margin clears the scrubber + end cards.

youtube_4k.notes: 4K master. Only if the source resolves it - do not upscale-and-claim.

youtube_shorts.notes: Big right margin clears the like/comment/share rail; big bottom clears title + CTA.

instagram_reels.notes: Slightly larger bottom safe area than Shorts (caption + audio tag + CTA stack).

instagram_feed.notes: Square feed. Keep key action centered; feed crops aggressively in some surfaces.

instagram_portrait.notes: 4:5 portrait feed - the most screen real estate without going vertical-video.

tiktok.notes: Largest bottom + right safe area: username, caption, and the big action rail all stack low-right.

linkedin.notes: Often watched muted - burn captions. Professional tone.

cinematic.notes: Ultra-wide 21:9 at 24fps for a filmic hero. Letterbox a 16:9 source rather than crop faces.
